source_note: 原有访客记录保留旧证据；本轮新增记录逐条附普通 Wiki 来源、更新时间与显式颜色。既有实机 raw 不以 Wiki 覆盖。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I think I am really onto something here.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我觉得自己这次真的发现了什么。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: Jake 说自己不能走路,可我昨天明明看见他走路了。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 他还让陌生人替他找些动物,可这些动物根本无处可寻!

messages.text: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我离揭开这个谜团真的很近了。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 今天我跟着他到了他安置抓来动物的地方。他进了一座奇怪的洞穴……

messages.text: Unfortunately, I couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so I backed off for now.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 可惜他差点发现我,我没法继续跟下去,只好暂时撤退。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 今天我成功跟他进了洞。他带着一把铲子,还有张纸条从口袋里掉了出来……

messages.context: Beth 花园委托的剧情线索；保留坐标与玩家高亮
messages.text: The note reads: "175 42 -470"
messages.gloss: 175 42 -470 是固定任务地点，非动态采样数值。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:06.
messages.raw: §fThe note reads: "§d175 42 -470§f"

messages.text: Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, do you have any ideas?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我还不确定这些数字是什么意思,你有什么头绪吗?

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave???
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 你找到了什么? 藏在洞里的秘密实验室???

messages.text: We need to check this out together. I'll meet you there!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我们得一起去查个究竟。我会在那里等你!

messages.context: Beth 花园委托的剧情线索；保留坐标与玩家高亮
messages.text: Hey, %1$s, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.
messages.gloss: 玩家名来自 Wiki 变量标记；保留实时玩家样式。
messages.zh: 嘿，%1$s，我一直在想我们找到的那间实验室……我觉得它不只是有些毛绒玩具那么简单。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 24 August 2026, at 06:06.
messages.raw: §fHey, §7%1$s§f, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.

segments.text: , I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.
segments.zh: ，我一直在想我们找到的那间实验室……我觉得它不只是有些毛绒玩具那么简单。

messages.text: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. I need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 尤其是那些奇怪的机器和实验。我又需要你帮忙了……我们在实验室见。

messages.text: Maybe I was wrong to trust you...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 也许我不该相信你……

messages.raw: §fThat Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
messages.text: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
messages.zh: 那个叫 Jake 的家伙有点可疑。

messages.context: 沙漠定居点与 Beth 对话
messages.raw: §fHe says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
messages.text: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
messages.zh: 他说他出不了门，但我明明总看见他在外面到处晃悠……

messages.raw: §fMaybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.
messages.text: Maybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页逐字与显式颜色；未实机核验。
messages.zh: 也许你该去我跟踪他时去过的那个洞穴看看。我记得那里有很多蘑菇。

messages.raw: §fSeems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.
messages.text: Seems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通呈现页逐字与显式颜色；未实机核验。
messages.zh: 看来是我误会 Jake 了，他可能没有我想的那么可疑。

messages.zh: 谢谢你帮我查清了 Jake 的事。

note:
身份：沙漠定居点居民，追查 Jake 的秘密实验室。
关系：与玩家合作调查；对 Jake 从怀疑、愤怒转为理解并愿意协助。
口吻：敏锐直率，惊讶时会大声质问，发现误会也肯道歉。
性格：好奇执着，重视动物安全和研究责任。
禁用风格：不替玩家解谜，不把怀疑说成已证实的罪行，不破坏与 Jake 的关系转折。
